extracted.intended_audience: news publishers, newsroom staff, and site owners using Google News / Publisher Center (newsroom and SEO teams)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for publishers on the algorithmic ranking signals Google News uses to rank and feature stories, covering story-level and publisher-level factors as well as originality and technical requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: How well the article matches reader query, interest, or current trends
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the three primary factors; includes topic match and alignment with user intent and current trending topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prominence
rubrics_metrics.description: How prominent the story is at the moment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the three primary factors; reflects the newsworthiness and salience of a story in the current news cycle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authoritativeness
rubrics_metrics.description: Trust signals: bylines, publisher reputation, citations from others
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the three primary factors; evaluates publisher and author reputation, transparent authorship, and external citations or references that indicate trustworthiness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Freshness
rubrics_metrics.description: Recency; how recently published; how often updated
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Story-level signal: newer and frequently updated articles are favored. Speed and recency are emphasized as implicit newsworthiness criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevance to query
rubrics_metrics.description: Topic match between article content and user query
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Story-level signal: semantic/topic matching to user interests or search queries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Click data
rubrics_metrics.description: User behavior signals (clicks)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Story-level signal: engagement metrics such as click-throughs inform ranking; listed among implicit newsworthiness criteria as 'user signal (clicks)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography / Geographic relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Localization and geographic relevance of the story
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Story-level signal: how relevant the content is to the user's location or geographic interests; also listed among implicit criteria as 'geographic relevance.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Image presence and quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Presence of visual assets and their quality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Story-level signal: articles with strong visual assets (images) are favored; echoed by implicit criterion 'visual asset presence.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Schema markup (NewsArticle JSON-LD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of structured data (NewsArticle JSON-LD)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Story-level technical signal: implement NewsArticle schema to help Google understand article metadata; part of technical SEO compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publisher authority in topic area
rubrics_metrics.description: Publisher's topical authority and reputation in a subject area
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publisher-level signal: authority within specific topic categories (e.g., established outlets in business news) improves ranking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Volume of original content in category
rubrics_metrics.description: Amount/volume of original reporting a publisher produces in a given category
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publisher-level signal: publishers producing substantial original content in a topic area are favored.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consistent publishing cadence
rubrics_metrics.description: Regular and consistent publishing schedule
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publisher-level signal: steady cadence supports visibility and signals reliability to the algorithm.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparent authorship (author bylines, bios)
rubrics_metrics.description: Clear authorship markers such as bylines and author bios
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publisher-level signal: transparent authorship contributes to authoritativeness and trust signals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Site speed and mobile optimization
rubrics_metrics.description: Fast site performance and mobile-friendly design
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publisher-level technical signal: site speed and mobile optimization are important for ranking and are noted under implicit 'technical SEO compliance.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to Google's content policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance with Google News content policies
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publisher-level requirement: following content policies is necessary for inclusion and ranking; violations can harm visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: History of original reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Publisher's historical record of original reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publisher-level signal: a track record of original reporting increases trust and ranking potential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original reporting over aggregation
rubrics_metrics.description: Algorithms favor original reporting over aggregation or rewrites
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Originality section: being 'first on the story' and producing original content is rewarded by the algorithm.

rubrics_metrics.name: First-on-story boost / 'Highly Cited' badge
rubrics_metrics.description: Being first on a story can yield boosts such as a 'Highly Cited' badge
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Originality signal: cross-publisher citation and being early on a developing story can generate special badges and ranking advantages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-referenced citations across publishers
rubrics_metrics.description: Algorithms cross-reference citations and coverage among publishers
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Originality and authoritativeness signal: widespread citation of an article by other publishers can increase its prominence and trust signals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speed and recency (implicit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Timeliness and promptness in reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under implicit newsworthiness criteria; overlaps with Freshness but emphasizes competitive speed to publish breaking news.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical authority (implicit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Depth of expertise and consistent coverage in a topic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implicit criterion reinforcing publisher authority and subject-matter reputation as a ranking factor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand recognition (implicit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognition of the publisher brand among audiences
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implicit factor: well-known brands may receive prominence due to established trust and recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical SEO compliance (implicit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical site factors such as schema, speed, and mobile optimization
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implicit criterion that groups schema markup, site speed, mobile readiness, and other technical best practices affecting discoverability and ranking.
